verdict.rationale: Metronome documents a broad API surface: usage ingestion, billable metric create/archive, contract creation and editing, subscription lifecycle and seat changes, custom fields, pagination, idempotency, multi-language SDKs, and a published OpenAPI spec. That covers most core billing workflows programmatically. However, nothing states UI/API parity, and some functions appear UI-centric: API tokens are created through the Metronome app, and the event explorer is described as a UI feature. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API-based token management, an API equivalent for event pipeline inspection, and independent or hands-on corroboration of full coverage.
